summary.text: Linda Longstreth is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 75, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and a former delegate who assumed office in 2004 and left on December 1, 2020.
She is an educator and administrator by profession.

paragraphs.text: Longstreth earned a bachelor's degree from Fairmont State College and a master's degree from West Virginia University.
She served as a Staff Sergeant in the U.S. Army Reserve in 1981, and her professional experience includes work as an educator and administrator.
Longstreth first won election to the House of Delegates in 2004, representing District 43, and was re-elected there through 2010.
She won District 50 in 2012, 2014, 2016 and 2018 and did not run for re-election in 2020.

During the 2019-2020 session she served on the Finance, Political Subdivisions, Senior Citizen Issues, and Veterans Affairs and Homeland Security committees, and was the minority chair of Veterans Affairs.
In 2026 she won the Democratic primary for District 75, where incumbent Republican Phil Mallow is also on the ballot.
